| Dataset | Shape | Dtype |
|---------|-------|-------|

| /crs | () (scalar) | uint8 |
| /das | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| /t | (30000,) | float64 |
| /trace | (30000,) | int64 |
| /x | (384,) | float32 |
| /y | (384,) | float32 |
| /z | (384,) | float32 |

Interpretation: /das is the main DAS strain-rate array (30,000 time samples x 384 channels); /t and /trace are the per-sample time and trace-index vectors; /x, /y, /z and /channel give the 384 channel locations/identifiers; /crs is a scalar coordinate-reference-system flag.
